card.name: Linking words after acetaminophen combination names
card.fires_on: The small linking word (and, or, an opening quote, including) right after acetaminophen or another combination-product drug name, where a second drug name is expected next. Also fires inside dextromethorphan-type names.

modes.label: Link after acetaminophen
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'or' directly after acetaminophen, before codeine or APAP.
modes.example: Acetaminophen<< and>> codeine phosphate oral solution is contrain

modes.label: Link in multi-drug lists
modes.description: 'and' after a comma in lists of combined drug ingredients, or after codeine.
modes.example: Brompheniramine Maleate, Pseudoephedrine Hydrochloride,<< and>> Dextromethorphan Hydrob

card.writes: It pushes toward drug-name beginnings such as pseudo, acet and par, which suits the second ingredient in a combination product.
card.plain: It marks the small joining word after one drug name in a combination product, just before the next ingredient is named.
